cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept my sunglasses on like you. Two brave faces. Did Mum cancelling our birthday dinner hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These are prescription; I left my other pair at home. Did it hurt you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep them on, then. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I cried buying the candles too. I told the cashier it was allergies.
